text: 你觉得日记里的信息对自己至关重要，于是忍不住出价。你把自己的报价单和其他人的放在一起，希望沃伦先生比较报价时会叫到你的名字。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 6
text: You feel that the information in the journal is essential to your interests, and you cannot help but make a bid. You place your paper with the others and hope that Mr. Warren calls your name when the amounts are compared.
